title: The Frost Feather on the Pane
youtube_title: The Frost Feather on the Pane | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Noemi finds a frost feather on the bedroom pane. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Noemi shows Sora how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
